title: Editor Overview
description: The Lupis Engine workspace brings scene editing, visual scripting, animation, and asset management into one window. Learn where each panel is and how to navigate the workspace.

blocks.content: The editor surrounds the central [Scene Viewport](interface/scene_viewport) with the [Scene Hierarchy](interface/scene_hierarchy) on the left, the [Property Inspector](interface/property_inspector) on the right, and the resource dock at the bottom. Panels resize, collapse, and switch automatically when you open different workspace tabs.

blocks.content: The workspace is divided into five main areas. When you open a tool tab such as the **Tilemap Editor**, **Shape Editor**, **Animator Editor**, or a script graph, the side panels and bottom dock adapt to that tool.

rows: Contains the **Project Menu** on the left, the save status dot, and open workspace tabs across the top.
Left panel (**Hierarchy** or **UI Structure**) that organizes scenes, layers, and parent-child entities.
Center canvas where you arrange entities, paint tiles, draw shapes, or connect script nodes.
Right panel (**Inspector**) that edits the selected scene, layer, entity, or script node.
Collapsible bottom drawer with tabs for **Assets**, **Scripts**, **Console**, and **Prefabs** (or **Timeline** when editing animations).

blocks.content: Click the project name in the top-left corner to open the **Project Menu**. The colored dot next to the project name shows your current save state.

rows: The project is currently loading or saving.
Saves all scenes, assets, and settings (or press **Ctrl** + **S**).
Downloads the project as a **.lupisproject** backup archive. See [Project & Export](getting_started/project_and_export).
Opens project settings for resolution, physics, grid snapping, and debug bounds.
Closes the editor and returns to the project dashboard.

blocks.message: Click the currently active tab in the bottom bar (**Assets**, **Scripts**, **Console**, or **Prefabs**) to collapse the bottom dock and give more vertical space to the canvas.

blocks.content: Use the bottom overlay bar in the [Scene Viewport](interface/scene_viewport) to test your game and push changes without restarting from scratch.

items: In the bottom overlay bar of the **Scene Viewport**, click **Play**. The game preview opens.
Move an entity or edit a component property in the [Property Inspector](interface/property_inspector).
In the bottom overlay bar, click **Update**. The running preview refreshes with your latest changes.
Click **Ctrl** + **S** or open the **Project Menu** and click **Save Project** to keep your work.

blocks.content: Use the **Assets** panel in the bottom dock to import media files and assign them to entities.

items: In the bottom bar, click **Assets** to expand the **Assets** panel.
Drag image (**.png**, **.jpg**, **.webp**), font (**.ttf**, **.otf**), or audio (**.ogg**, **.mp3**, **.wav**) files from your computer into the panel, or click **+** to browse.
Select a target entity in the [Scene Hierarchy](interface/scene_hierarchy).
Right-click the asset in the **Assets** panel and click **Apply to SpriteRenderer**, **Apply to Tilemap**, **Apply to TextRenderer**, or **Apply to Audio Component**.

blocks.message: Drag the divider edge of the left panel, right panel, or bottom dock to resize it. Click the collapse icon in a side panel header to fold it into a narrow bar.
